content.title: Avalon Arvada (Welby Center)
content.summary: The Avalon Arvada (Welby Center) project proposes the development of 384 multifamily units and 51 townhomes on a 20.1-acre site located at 17201 W 64th Ave. The project aims to create a cohesive residential community with a mix of housing types to accommodate Arvada's growing population, featuring a total of 435 units at a density of 20.5 dwelling units per acre. Key dates include a Planning Commission public hearing on January 21, 2026, and a City Council public hearing on April 21, 2026.
content.body:
![Aerial view of Welby Center development project](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6884)

## DA2025-0035

### Project Name: Avalon Arvada (Welby Center)

**Project Information:**Conditional Use to allow 384 multifamily and 51 townhome units on site

- **Address/Location:** 17201 W 64th Ave
- **Developer:**TBD
- **Planner:**Rozalynne Thompson
- **Acres:**20.1
- **Use:**Residential
- **Total Units:**384 Multifamily and 51 Townhomes
- **Planning Commission Public Hearing:** Jan. 21, 2026
- **City Council First Reading:** March 24, 2026
- **City Council Public Hearing:** April 21, 2026

**Project Narrative from the Developer:** The proposed mixed-density residential community includes a mix of housing types and designs to create an aesthetically attractive development which provides housing for a diverse range of future residents. The configuration of residential structures will create a cohesive residential community with a suburban character, consistent with the purpose of the Mixed-Use, Suburban (MX-S) zone district, while enabling higher density development and accommodating attainably priced housing for Arvada’s growing population.

The site plan proposes eight (8) townhome buildings ranging from 4-8 units per building, totaling fifty-one (51) units. The townhomes are anticipated to be a mix of two- and three-bedroom units. The site plan also includes twelve (12) breezeway and corridor multi-family buildings, providing 384 apartment units through a mix of studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments. Ten buildings are proposed to be 3-stories, and 2 buildings are proposed to be 4-stories. All residential buildings are proposed not to exceed the maximum height of 45’. In total, this residential community proposes 435 units at a density of 20.5 DU/Acre. There is no density maximum for Mixed-Use Suburban zone district or Mixed-Use comprehensive plan land use designation. The proposed community is consistent with the height of the existing MorningStar community and is less dense.

[Learn more about the project.](https://aca-prod.accela.com/ARVADA)
